rule_text: Drawings must be correct scale in all the sheets
evidence: Cover sheet (H8099-00) correctly has no scale. All other sheets have scales specified: H8099-G1 (50mm A3), H8099-G2 (SCALE 1:2000), H8099-G3 (SCALE 1:100), H8099-G3-1 (SCALE 1:10), H8099-G4 (SCALE 1:100), H8099-A1 (no scale - table sheet, acceptable), H8099-A2 (no scale - table sheet, acceptable), H8099-A3 (no scale - table sheet, acceptable), H8099-P1 (no scale - diagram, acceptable), H8099-F1 (SCALE 1:20), H8099-F1-1 (SCALE N1.5), H8099-F1-2 (SCALE N1.5). All technical drawing sheets requiring scale have appropriate scales mentioned.

CAD viewport shows Annotation scale 1:100 and Standard scale 1:100_1, but the drawing detail indicates scale 1:100. The standard scale value 1:100_1 does not match the annotation scale 1:100, indicating a mismatch between the viewport scale configuration and the stated annotation scale.

rule_text: FC stamp is correctly mentioned to all sheets?
evidence: DRAFT watermark is not visible on all sheets. The document pages display 'FOR CONSTRUCTION' stamp instead of 'DRAFT' watermark. Sheets H8099-00, H8099-G1, H8099-G2, H8099-G3, H8099-G3-1, H8099-G4, H8099-A1, H8099-A2, H8099-A3, H8099-P1, H8099-F1, H8099-F1-1, and H8099-F1-2 all show 'FOR CONSTRUCTION' designation without visible DRAFT watermark overlay.

Layer naming convention not consistently applied. Review of layer list shows inconsistent formatting: Existing elements use varied text colors (red, gray, yellow, cyan, magenta) without clear unbold distinction. Proposed/New elements also use varied colors (yellow, red, cyan) without consistent bold styling. Examples of issues: 'Ant Panel Exist' (gray), 'Ant Panel New' (yellow) - color differentiation present but boldface styling cannot be confirmed from text rendering. 'Cable Ladder Exist' (gray) vs 'Cable Ladder New' (yellow) - same issue. 'Conc Line 0.50' (magenta/red) lacks clear existing/proposed distinction. The As-built drawings (H8099-G2, G3, G4, F1, etc.) do not show explicit layer bold/unbold formatting verification. Recommend: Verify CAD layer properties (WEIGHT/STYLE attributes) in source file to confirm existing layers are set to light/unbold and proposed layers to bold.

Address 'LOT 13 PLAN 178737, POIMENA RESERVE, WAKEHURST RD, AUSTINS FERRY, TAS 7011' verified on cover sheet and site address sheet. JV Site ID 'JH3038' confirmed on cover sheet and RFSNA reference (7011007) visible.
